description.value:
You have a knack for battlefield medicine. Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When you use a traumakit to stabilize a dying creature, that creature also regains 1 hit point. Additionally, as an action you can expend one use of a traumakit to treat a creature, restoring 1d6 + 4 hit points to it plus a number of additional hit points equal to the creature's maximum number of Hit Dice. A creature can't benefit from this treatment again until it finishes a short or long rest.
